chunks: This is on the lines of his saying (peace be upon him): 'Two categories of persons will be ruined over me: the one who loves exaggeratingly and the hater and malicebearer.'

key_terms.مُبْغِضٌ قَالٍ: The hater who bears malice/exaggerates hatred

ai.seo_question: What are the two extremes that lead to ruin in relation to the Imams according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Raḍī highlights the dialectic of ghulūw (exaggeration) and qalūw (superficiality) as the twin paths to spiritual ruin, distinguishing between the Ghawṣiyyūn who overstate the Imam's divinity and the Qawāṣiyyūn who dismiss his authority. This maxim underscores the Shia principle of 'middle way' (wasatiyyah) in adhering to the Ahl al-Bayt, warning against both blind fanaticism and baseless criticism.

en.sayed-ali-raza: This is on the lines of Amīr al-mu’minin’s own saying which runs as: “Two categories of persons will be ruined over me: the one who loves exaggeratingly and the hater and malicebearer.” [1]
